name: Geneva hip phantom (BV Pulsera; D'Isidoro et al., Medical Physics 2021)

pairing.pose: stored: gold-standard rigid transforms and the projection matrix
pairing.annotate: nothing for the spine; a registration check on a C-arm no other set comes from
pairing.pair_key: one phantom: every frame pairs with its one CT

what: 116 fluoroscopy frames of one hip phantom on a Philips BV Pulsera C-arm, with the phantom's CT, a gold-standard rigid transform for each frame and the projection matrix

segmentations.masks: none: the release ships the phantom's CT, its transforms and the projection matrix, no masks

segmentations.by: the owner's runs, automatic (SPINEPS); no radiologist has read them

licence: CC BY-SA 4.0, as the source's page gives it (read 2026-10-23), which also lists a 'Contract on the use of data' and shows none of its terms
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/geneva_hip_src, fetched by the owner; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/geneva_hip/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/geneva_hip_src, fetched by the owner, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry

the source's page on Yareta (the link; doi 10.26037/yareta:2kw5s2jadbbv3ngtkzsovihtnu, the paper Medical Physics 48(10) 2021, doi 10.1002/mp.15124) read: CC BY-SA 4.0, public, with a 'Contract on the use of data' whose terms it does not show; it gives no frame count or C-arm, so what stays as the registry gives it; link and licence written

obstacles: the owner's hand: the source's page lists a contract on the use of data with no terms shown; whether one binds the copy on the grid is his decision
